definitions.explanation: All eight compass directions (the four cardinal and four intermediate directions), or more generally, all directions.

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}から{攻撃|こうげき}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: To be attacked from all directions.

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}{塞|ふさ}がりで{困|こま}っている。
examples.english: I'm stuck with no way out (blocked in all directions).

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}{美人|びじん}と{言|い}われたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to be called a people-pleaser (someone who tries to please everyone).

examples.japanese: {八方|はっぽう}{手|て}を{尽|つ}くしたが、{解決|かいけつ}{策|さく}が{見|み}つからなかった。
examples.english: I tried every possible means, but couldn't find a solution.

examples.japanese: {四方|しほう}{八方|はっぽう}から{風|かぜ}が{吹|ふ}いてきて、テントが{飛|と}ばされそうになった。
examples.english: Wind blew from every direction and the tent nearly blew away.

notes:
THE EIGHT DIRECTIONS:
・{東|ひがし} (east)
・{西|にし} (west)
・{南|みなみ} (south)
・{北|きた} (north)
・{北東|ほくとう} (northeast)
・{北西|ほくせい} (northwest)
・{南東|なんとう} (southeast)
・{南西|なんせい} (southwest)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{八方|はっぽう}{塞|ふさ}がり (blocked in all directions; no way out)
・{八方|はっぽう}{美人|びじん} (lit. 'beauty in all directions'; someone who tries to please everyone, often negative)
・{八方|はっぽう}{手|て}を{尽|つ}くす (to try every possible means)

RELATED TERMS:
・{四方|しほう} (four directions)
・{四方八方|しほうはっぽう} (all directions, everywhere)
・{全方位|ぜんほうい} (all directions, omnidirectional)
